notes.title: Demo 0.10.6 Update
notes.content:
[p]We're currently developing an outdoor exploration and resource collection system, but it hasn't been implemented yet.[/p][p]Pixels make up 90% of the game's size, and we'll strive to reduce the file size without sacrificing image quality.[/p][p]Subsequent updates may experience lower or higher pixel quality due to these adjustments.

Update:[/p][list][*][p]Added some map details[/p][/*][*][p]Added footstep sounds for stepping on water[/p][/*][*][p]Added Sirius' shop-watching animation[/p][/*][*][p]Added effects and sounds for sinks[/p][/*][*][p]Added ESC function to close windows[/p][/*][*][p]Added required furniture for recipes[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted walkable areas for lakes and rivers[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted alignment of roads with terrain[/p][/*][*][p]Furniture and tools will now automatically populate the quick access slot (furniture placement will now include aiming functionality)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed character sleeping animations, allowing players to wake them up in the middle of the night[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where characters would disappear when downstairs in a player's house[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced game size to 1.22G[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192906/2063dd750af95dd08964031ac70c585fe33b2083.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo 0.10.1 Update
notes.content: [p]This update focuses on the rhythm game and the final event.[/p][p]The last update for this area was last year's Bloodstain 2.[/p][p][/p][p]Update:[/p][list][*][p]Increased the responsiveness of the rhythm game and invasion events.[/p][/*][*][p]Added basic rhythm game sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased difficulty adjustment for invasion events.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a basic tutorial for invasion events.[/p][/*][*][p]Added sound effects and special effects for invasion events.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a health bar for invasion events.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the continuous click gameplay for invasion events.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the attack range determination for the rhythm game.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduces flashing in the plot and dims the highlighted screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the invasion event could be exited.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the shop screen would freeze due to frequent opening and closing.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.balance_change: Increased the responsiveness of the rhythm game and invasion events.

tags.feature: Added basic rhythm game sound effects.

tags.balance_change: Increased difficulty adjustment for invasion events.

Added sound effects and special effects for invasion events.
Added a health bar for invasion events.

tags.balance_change: Improved the continuous click gameplay for invasion events.
Improved the attack range determination for the rhythm game.
Reduces flashing in the plot and dims the highlighted screen.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where the invasion event could be exited.
Fixed a bug where the shop screen would freeze due to frequent opening and closing.

notes.title: Demo v0.10.0 Update
notes.content: [p]We've finally fixed all the more serious issues and can move on to other development. [/p][p][/p][p]Update:[/p][list][*][p]Added a jump function[/p][/*][*][p]Added a 24-hour shop, eliminating the need to wait for NPCs to arrive[/p][/*][*][p]Added underwater camera visual effects (this was just a quick use, as the game doesn't plan on letting players go underwater)[/p][/*][*][p]Added two types of flowers[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the background music system[/p][/*][*][p]Revised the inventory and quick menu functionality (a future update will allow players to place furniture directly without entering the layout mode)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some scene issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where NPCs would move while browsing the shop[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized loading times at game startup[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added a jump function
Added a 24-hour shop, eliminating the need to wait for NPCs to arrive
Added underwater camera visual effects (this was just a quick use, as the game doesn't plan on letting players go underwater)
Added two types of flowers
Improved the background music system
Revised the inventory and quick menu functionality (a future update will allow players to place furniture directly without entering the layout mode)

tags.bug: Fixed some scene issues
Fixed a bug where NPCs would move while browsing the shop
Optimized loading times at game startup

notes.title: Demo v0.9.20 Update
notes.content: [p]Because some people are experiencing serious issues that are preventing them from playing,[/p][p]This update primarily addresses the bug reporting feature. This button can be found on the pause screen in the game.[/p][p]For the developer's protection, you must agree to this data collection statement. Please understand.[/p][p][/p][p]Update Content:[/p][list][*][p]Added bug reporting functionality[/p][/*][*][p]Minor adjustments to interaction distances[/p][/*][*][p]Added a quick item slot at the bottom (not yet linked to the item slot)[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the interaction distance for the cafe sign[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the story system dialog resetting[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with background music switching being triggered by regular NPCs[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added bug reporting functionality
Added a quick item slot at the bottom (not yet linked to the item slot)

tags.balance_change: Adjusted the interaction distance for the cafe sign

tags.bug: Fixed an issue with the story system dialog resetting
Fixed an issue with background music switching being triggered by regular NPCs
